original_requirement: resolve the exact non-secret A1 network destination, bind it and the exact egress classes into a fresh Approval V3/nonce contract, enforce the binding in the real dispatcher, then stop before approval or dispatch
operational_definition: one sealed pilot, one fixed A1 sample, one primary route fingerprint, one provider/model binding, one HTTPS origin and one API path
forbidden_narrowing: no hostname-only authorization without scheme, port, path, operator classification, and egress disclosure
no caller or environment base URL override
no proxy, redirect, retry, fallback, route switch, resume, or second dispatch
no Approval V3 or nonce creation before a new destination-naming user authorization
no production runtime, Prompt, Skill, Planning, story authority, or output-contract change
closed_world_justification: the experiment identity, A1 input, route/provider/model hashes, local provider row, exact origin, exact path, caps, and excluded actions are finite and sealed

constraint_traceability.requirement: resolve one exact non-secret destination from sealed route plus local SQLite metadata
bind exact destination and egress policy into Approval V3 and durable nonce V2
fail closed before credential lookup or network dispatch on destination drift
one POST only with redirects, proxies, fallback, route switch, and legacy approval disabled
constraint_traceability.implementation: SingleDispatchTransportPolicyV1 plus launch_real_a1_once_v1 fail-close plus launch_real_a1_once_v3

projected_failure_mechanisms: wrong scheme, host, port, or API path
approval destination or egress hash tamper
local provider row changes after approval
HTTP redirect to a second origin
fallback or route switch to a second origin
second POST after transport or validation failure
why_previous_tests_missed: the blocked V2 execution proved single-dispatch and real-boundary realization but deliberately stopped because its approval did not name a concrete destination or disclose exact egress classes; destination authority therefore was not part of the approval/nonce/dispatcher test surface

sibling_boundaries.evidence: all changes are under tools/canary or tests/canary; src and baml_src bytes are unchanged and the canary module is not imported by production
